nodes.name: IM-EISA precursor film formation
nodes.procedure: 0.3 g of PF resin, 0.06 g of MF resin, and 0.6 g of PEO-b-PS were dissolved in 30 mL of THF, stirred 2 h. 0.6 g PMA added, sonicated 1 h, stirred 1 h. NM precursor added (for Pt: 802 μL chloroplatinic acid solution), sonicated 0.5 h, stirred 0.5 h. Solution poured into Petri dish, covered, evaporated at 323 K for 12 h. Film annealed at 373 K for 48 h. Films from two dishes peeled, ground 10 min.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of aNM/Mo_xC (thermodynamic approach; high-T annealing [dynamic placement] with IM-EISA)... finely ground together manually in an agate mortar for 10 min.

unit_operations.name: Polymer dissolution
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: 0.3 g of PF resin, 0.06 g of MF resin, and 0.6 g of PEO-b-PS were dissolved in 30 mL of THF, then the mixture was stirred under ambient conditions for 2 h

unit_operations.name: PMA incorporation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: 0.6 g of PMA was added... sonicating for 1 h, then stirring for 1 h

unit_operations.name: NM precursor addition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: NM precursor solution was added... sonicating for 0.5 h then stirring for 0.5 h

unit_operations.name: EISA film formation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: mixture solution was poured into a Petri dish... evaporated at 323 K for 12 h

unit_operations.name: Film annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: resulting film was further annealed at 373 K for 48 h

nodes.name: First thermal treatment
nodes.procedure: Powder annealed under Ar (200 sccm): 723 K (3 h, 1 K/min ramp), 873 K (1 K/min ramp), 1123 K (6 h, 5 K/min ramp), cool to RT (5 K/min). Passivated: O2 (2 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) 12 h, then O2 (4 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) 12 h. Ground 10 min.
nodes.source_text: (i) First thermal treatment (Pt/Mo_xC-C at 1123 K)... finely ground in an agate mortar for 10 min.

unit_operations.name: Multi-stage annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: annealed under Ar flow (200 sccm) at 723 K for 3 h... 1123 K for 6 h

unit_operations.name: Passivation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: passivated under O2 (2 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) flow for 12 h, then O2 (4 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) for 12 h

nodes.name: Air activation
nodes.procedure: In a tube furnace, the resulting powder was annealed under O2 (20 sccm)/Ar (80 sccm) (20 vol% O2/Ar) flow at 403 K for 6 h (2 K min^-1), then RT (2 K min^-1). After the sample had reached RT, the resulting powder was finely ground in an agate mortar for 10 min.
nodes.source_text: (ii) Second thermal treatment, air activation... finely ground in an agate mortar for 10 min.

nodes.name: Final dynamic placement
nodes.procedure: Powder annealed under Ar (200 sccm) at 1373 K for 6 h (5 K/min ramp), cool to RT (5 K/min). Passivated: O2 (2 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) 12 h, O2 (4 sccm)/Ar (200 sccm) 12 h. Final grinding 10 min.
nodes.source_text: (iii) Final thermal treatment (final carburization)... The obtained powder was finely ground in an agate mortar for 10 min.

unit_operations.name: Final carburization
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: annealed under Ar (200 sccm) flow at 1373 K for 6 h (5 K min^-1)

nodes.description: HER performance in H2-saturated 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: under alkaline conditions (H2-saturated 1 M KOH), the samples prepared via dynamic placement (aPt/Mo xC, aRh/Mo xC, Pt/Mo xC_Ar) exhibited higher HER activity, lower η10 (aNM/Mo xC; ~26 mV), and lower Rct than commercial Pt/C and Pt/Mo xC_H2

nodes.description: HOR performance in H2-saturated 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the alkaline HOR activity of the samples obtained via dynamic placement surpassed that of Pt/C and Pt/Mo xC_H2. Compared to Pt/C and Pt/Mo xC_H2, aNM/Mo xC had 1.8-fold higher j0 and 4.7-fold higher kinetic current density at 25 mV per NM moles

nodes.source_text: aNM/Mo xC and Pt/Mo xC_Ar exhibited better CO tolerance than Pt/C and Pt/Mo xC_H2

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM images with EDS mappings show Pt NPs (<5 nm) uniformly distributed on both Mo_xC and carbon before final thermal treatment, and selectively/atomically dispersed on Mo_xC after 1373 K treatment (Fig. 1d,e).
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) with energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) mapping revealed that the Pt NPs < 5 nm were uniformly distributed on both carbon and Mo_x C ... after the final thermal treatment at 1373 K (carburization), the Pt species were homogeneously and selectively distributed on the Mo_x C supports without forming agglomerates

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution HAADF-STEM Z-contrast images show numerous bright dots on Mo_xC lattices and shell-like Pt distributions surrounding Mo_xC supports, confirming Pt ADCs on Mo_xC surface (Fig. 1f).
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM-EDS mapping revealed shell-like Pt distributions surrounding the Mo_x C supports, and the STEM Z-contrast images (Fig. 1f) exhibited numerous bright dots on the Mo_x C lattices, indicating that the Pt ADCs were located on the Mo_x C supports

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ high-resolution TEM with FFT and inverse FFT shows Pt nanoparticles disappearing as temperature increases from 298 to 1373 K during carburization.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM) measurements ... revealed that two Pt NPs were loaded on Mo_x C-C ... As T increased, the Pt NPs disappeared (Fig. 1i–k and Fig. S9b, S10, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD indicates crystalline Pt disappeared after final thermal treatment.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Similarly, X-ray diffraction (XRD) indicated that crystalline Pt disappeared (Fig. S6, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt 4f XPS spectra of aPt/Mo_xC show metallic Pt characteristics similar to Pt black.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) of aPt/Mo_x C and Pt/Mo_x C_Ar in the Pt 4f region revealed that the Pt species possessed metallic characteristics similar to those of Pt black (Fig. 3b).

nodes.characterization_summary: XANES spectra at Pt L3-edge show aNM/Mo_xC has similar white line intensity to NM foil, confirming metallic characteristics of NM ADCs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) region, aNM/Mo_x C displayed a similar white line intensity (for the L3-edge) or edge shift (for the K-edge) to those of NM foil, indicating that the NM ADCs exhibited metallic characteristics

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS fitting shows Pt-Pt CN decreased from ~8 to 0; aNM/Mo_xC stabilized by ~3 NM-C bonds (~0.1 Å longer than NM-O) with Pt-Mo bond length ~2.84 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Pt–Pt coordination for aPt/Mo_x C decreased from ∼8 to 0 during final carburization. Additionally, aNM/Mo_x C was stabilized by approximately three of NM–C bonds ... The bond length of Pt–Mo in aPt/Mo_x C (∼2.84 Å) differed from others (∼2.72 Å)

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ TEM/STEM-EDS at identical positions shows Pt NPs on Mo_xC-C disintegrate and selectively form Pt ADCs on Mo_xC after 1373 K annealing.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM-EDS mapping at an identical position revealed that the Pt NPs disintegrated completely and that the Pt ADCs were selectively loaded on the Mo_x C supports after annealing (Fig. 1g and Fig. S11, ESI†)
